description: Evidence-separated verification matrix for generated bindings, native runtimes, compiler tooling, target projections, the War Battles example, release staging, and repository knowledge.

rows.title: Defold script binding stack
rows.scope: The complete generated script projection, native Lua routing, and clean-room ownership for all pinned script routes.

generation.claim: The canonical script lowering plan and its transitive generator inputs are current.

compile.claim: Generated native extension sources pass the repository syntax compile gate.

link.claim: The generated handle router links into its dedicated pinned-Lua host executable.

runtime.claim: The generated handle routes execute through the pinned Lua host harness; this is not packaged-engine execution.

packaged-engine.claim: Packaged-engine route behavior requires SHA-bound real-engine observations.
packaged-engine.reason: The checked reports retain planned and instrumented scenarios, but the repository does not contain a complete current packaged-engine observation for the whole script surface.

sanitizer.claim: A whole-script-wave sanitizer run must be recorded independently from host runtime success.
sanitizer.reason: Individual native families have sanitizer evidence, but no single existing command proves sanitizer coverage for the entire script stack.

allocation.claim: The generated handle router's warmed path retains its explicit zero-allocation assertions.

clean-room.claim: Every registry-owned generated script artifact regenerates byte-for-byte from pinned inputs.

target.claim: Dynamic Hermes, Static Hermes, and browser target evidence must remain independently qualified.
target.reason: The canonical lowering plan still contains target-specific blocked and pending routes; one host target cannot promote the others.

rows.title: dmSDK structural binding stack
rows.scope: All 1,361 pinned dmSDK declarations, including generated scalar, span, C-string, and borrowed-handle structural waves.

generation.claim: The complete registered dmSDK generator pipeline is current.

compile.claim: The borrowed-handle C ABI, JSI source, pinned headers, browser descriptor, and TypeScript projections compile or parse.

arguments: C ABI, Dynamic Hermes adapter, browser descriptor, and TypeScript projections compile

link.claim: The borrowed-handle generic dispatcher links with its deterministic fake provider only.

runtime.claim: All generated borrowed-handle routes dispatch through a fake provider; this is not a Defold provider.

packaged-engine.claim: dmSDK adapters require real provider installation and packaged-engine observation.
packaged-engine.reason: Generated reports explicitly record zero packaged-engine verifications and no real borrowed-handle provider is installed.

sanitizer.claim: The fake-provider dispatcher runs under ASan and UBSan.

allocation.claim: The warmed generic borrowed-handle dispatcher retains its zero-C++-allocation assertion.

clean-room.claim: All registered dmSDK artifacts regenerate byte-for-byte from pinned inputs.

target.claim: Generated C, Dynamic Hermes, Static Hermes, browser, and TypeScript borrowed-handle projections pass their available compile-time gates.

arguments: C ABI, Dynamic Hermes adapter, browser descriptor, and TypeScript projections compile

rows.title: Typed component proxy and Hermes runtime
rows.scope: Generated .script.ts/.gui.ts/.render.ts proxies, the native Lua ABI gate, and the standalone Dynamic Hermes component harness.

generation.claim: The component runtime capability report is current and deterministic.

compile.claim: The generated native component capability gate compiles against its declared ABI.

link.claim: The standalone component Hermes harness links; this is not a packaged Defold engine.

runtime.claim: The standalone Dynamic Hermes/Lua component lifecycle harness executes.

packaged-engine.claim: Generated proxies must execute inside an actual packaged Defold engine.
packaged-engine.reason: The capability report labels the native Dynamic Hermes harness executable while keeping runtimeConformant false.

sanitizer.claim: The standalone component runtime is rebuilt and executed with the repository sanitizer option.

allocation.claim: Component lifecycle allocation behavior requires a dedicated warmed counter.
allocation.reason: The existing component harness checks roots, stack restoration, and lifecycle counts but does not publish a warmed allocation count.

clean-room.claim: Component proxy output needs a registered whole-family clean-room owner.
clean-room.reason: Deterministic golden and freshness tests exist, but there is no separate component-runtime clean-room orchestrator.

target.claim: Component execution must be proven separately for Dynamic Hermes, Static Hermes, and HTML5.
target.reason: Only the standalone native Dynamic Hermes harness is executable; Static Hermes and browser component runtime attachment are not available.

rows.title: Compiler, CLI, and generated project contexts
rows.scope: Project inspection, generated SDK contexts, type checking, and context-specific authoring contracts.

generation.claim: The War Battles project SDK and component proxies regenerate through the current CLI.

compile.claim: All generated shared, game-object, GUI, and render TypeScript context projects type-check.

link.claim: TypeScript project type checking does not establish native extension linkage.
link.reason: The CLI context project has no link stage of its own.

runtime.claim: Generated project contexts require a separate runtime consumer.
runtime.reason: CLI generation and type checking are compile-control-plane evidence only.

packaged-engine.claim: Generated project output must be run by a packaged Defold engine.
packaged-engine.reason: No CLI command result is accepted as packaged-engine gameplay evidence.

sanitizer.claim: TypeScript-only compiler paths do not have a native sanitizer stage.
sanitizer.reason: Sanitizers apply to downstream native runtimes, not the project type checker.

allocation.claim: Compiler allocation behavior needs an explicit benchmark or counter.
allocation.reason: No existing CLI evidence command publishes warmed allocation counts.

clean-room.claim: CLI generation remains deterministic across temporary project fixtures.

target.claim: Context-aware SDK projection rejects APIs outside their authored Defold contexts.

rows.title: Static Hermes target lane
rows.scope: Static Hermes source generation, language checks, native runner linkage, and target-specific execution.

generation.claim: The generated Static Hermes vmath bridge is current.

compile.claim: Static Hermes generated sources pass the repository compiler gate.

link.claim: The Static Hermes native runner links from the current generated sources.

runtime.claim: The Static Hermes host runner executes its checked fixture.

packaged-engine.claim: Static Hermes requires packaged-engine target execution in addition to its host runner.
packaged-engine.reason: The existing Static Hermes commands run host-side compiler and runner evidence, not a packaged Defold engine.

sanitizer.claim: A Static Hermes sanitizer run must be recorded separately.
sanitizer.reason: The existing Static Hermes package commands do not promise an ASan/UBSan configuration.

allocation.claim: Generated Static Hermes vmath glue retains its stack-only and float-lane assertions.

clean-room.claim: Static Hermes vmath generation is deterministic and rejects descriptor drift.

target.claim: Static Hermes target-specific generation and language constraints pass their focused tests.

rows.title: War Battles Online example
rows.scope: Deterministic 32-player simulation, replay/rollback harness, Defold project projection, and transport capability gates.

generation.claim: The Defold-local core projection, component proxy, and capability snapshot are current.

compile.claim: The isolated example and generated Defold project contexts type-check.

link.claim: The example must link into a packaged Defold engine before being called playable in-engine.
link.reason: The generated component gate is harness-executable but runtimeConformant remains false.

runtime.claim: The deterministic core, 32-player soak, rollback, replay, and in-memory transport execute headlessly.

packaged-engine.claim: War Battles gameplay must execute inside a packaged Defold engine.
packaged-engine.reason: The generated runtime gate records that packaged-engine gameplay execution has not been observed.

sanitizer.claim: The pure TypeScript headless example has no native sanitizer cell.
sanitizer.reason: Native sanitizer evidence belongs to the runtime adapters, not the in-memory simulation.

allocation.claim: Simulation allocation behavior needs a measured warmed counter.
allocation.reason: The current core is allocation-aware and fixed-capacity, but the checked evidence does not publish an allocation count.

clean-room.claim: The checked replay, soak, bundle, and Defold projection artifacts reproduce from their commands.

target.claim: WebTransport/H3 and native Defold client execution require real target probes.
target.reason: The browser Colyseus H3 handshake and native Defold WebTransport client remain unproven; WebSocket fallback is labelled as WebSocket.

rows.title: Release artifact projection
rows.scope: Content-addressed release selection and target-specific source projection without claiming final package execution.

generation.claim: Release selection is keyed, idempotent, and fails closed for targets without canonical authority.

compile.claim: Generated release sources require a separate target compile.
compile.reason: The release generator emits a source projection and requirements manifest; it does not claim every target compiles.

link.claim: Release projection must link through the selected target toolchain.
link.reason: Canonical implementation-object pruning and final target linkage remain outside the generator proof.

runtime.claim: A projected release requires target runtime execution.
runtime.reason: Idempotent source generation is not runtime evidence.

packaged-engine.claim: Release artifacts require packaged Defold engine execution.
packaged-engine.reason: No release-generation test is promoted to packaged-engine evidence.

sanitizer.claim: Release source projection has no sanitizer execution stage.
sanitizer.reason: Sanitizer evidence belongs to a linked runtime target.

allocation.claim: Release source projection has no warmed runtime allocation stage.
allocation.reason: Allocation evidence belongs to an executing target.

clean-room.claim: Temporary release outputs are keyed and idempotent.

target.claim: Dynamic Hermes, Static Hermes, and browser release authority remains target-specific.
target.reason: The current release tests explicitly fail closed where canonical emit authority is absent.

rows.title: Repository knowledge contract
rows.scope: OKF structure for decisions, evidence boundaries, roadmaps, and verification documentation.

generation.claim: All knowledge files retain the required OKF structure.

compile.claim: Markdown knowledge has no compile stage beyond structural validation.
compile.reason: The OKF structure command is recorded under generation/validation.

link.claim: Knowledge artifacts have no native link stage.

runtime.claim: Knowledge artifacts have no runtime stage.

packaged-engine.claim: Knowledge structure cannot establish packaged-engine execution.
packaged-engine.reason: Documentation records evidence; it is not execution evidence.

sanitizer.claim: Knowledge artifacts have no sanitizer stage.

allocation.claim: Knowledge artifacts have no allocation stage.

clean-room.claim: A separate knowledge clean-room reconstruction would need its own declared source graph.
clean-room.reason: The current OKF gate validates structure but does not regenerate prose.
